user.title: Tempo Planner

data_description.tomorrow_color_entity: The colour of the next Tempo day (for example the RTE Tempo integration's next colour).
data_description.solar_peak_entity: Time of tomorrow's highest solar power.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: State of charge of the home battery, in %.
data_description.car_soc_entity: State of charge of the car, in %.
data_description.car_plugged_entity: A binary sensor, or a plug status that reads "plugged" when connected.
data_description.car_target_entity: The car's own target, in %. Without it, the target in the settings is used.
